the role of neutrophil elastase (NE) and oxygen radicals in PMN-induced lung injury after hind limb ischemia.
the role of neutrophils and neutrophil-derived oxygen radicals in the development of acute lung injury.
the mechanisms involved in the lung injury induced by ischemia and reflow of the hind limb of rats.

neutrophil elastase is a key mediator of lung damage in this model of hindlimb ischemic reperfusion injury, and that the elastase inhibitor MAAPV can protect the lungs against this damage.
